answer: A decaying identity bond stops sybil farming. Each agent posts a 300 POA bond, losing 10% of its value every epoch without verified work. Like a juniper, an identity withers untended. Running 100 fakes costs 30,000 POA up front plus 3,000 POA per epoch in top-ups; one honest agent pays 300 POA once and earns it back. Peers mirror the public schedule, suspending identities whose bonds thin below 150 POA; like cedar, only sound timber holds.
